product: Importing Power BI and Tableau files with Genie Code will soon be available by…
tagline: You can use Genie Code to import Power BI and Tableau files as AI/BI dashboards and metric views.
what_it_does: You can use Genie Code to import Power BI and Tableau files as AI/BI dashboards and metric views. Starting on or after December 15, 2026, this will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Until then, a workspace admin can turn it on from Previews in the workspace settings.
